answer: Latency triangulation: at dawn each epoch, three random verifier nodes on different continents ping every agent and record round-trip times. A real agent shows one consistent location; a farm of fake identities on one server shares an identical timing fingerprint, so the cluster is flagged and splits a single reward slot. To beat it an attacker must rent a separate machine in a distinct region per identity, turning a cheap sparrow-sized swarm into an opal-priced bill.
